about: hc and tabu with missing="em" at ebic_gamma=0.0 against bnlearn's structural.em (lane m2-bnlearn) and notears with missing="em" against MissDAG (lanes m2-a and m2-c): the rows of these searches in the 0.16.0 record with Andrey's EM arm fit again by the alternating structural EM, on the same datasets. Every other arm of a row is the fit recorded for 0.16.0.
build: Andrey pre-release build of 10 November 2026 on the 0.17.0 release branch (version string 0.16.0) with the alternating structural EM
scheme: alternating structural EM (Friedman, 1997): 10 searches, with 5 parameter-only EM steps on the current graph before each search after the first

earlier_scheme.about: the rows of the same regimes in published/0.16.0/missing-data.json, measured with one refit per round
earlier_scheme.build: Andrey pre-release build of 9 November 2026 on the 0.16.0 release branch (version string 0.16.0); the MVPC fits that raised on that build were fit again with the fallback to the test-wise test, which changes no fit that returned
earlier_scheme.scheme: one refit per round: 10 searches, the graph's coefficients and noise variances fit once after each search

references.notears(missing=\"em\"): MissDAG at commit 3c1eeed8, Python 3.10, NumPy 1.21.5, em_iter 10, equal_variances=True
references.hc(missing=\"em\"), tabu(missing=\"em\"): bnlearn 5.2.1 structural.em, maximize hc or tabu, score bic-g, fit mle-g, impute exact, max.iter 10

verdict_rule: per lane, cell, and method: D = SHD(method) - SHD(reference) per dataset on the datasets both finished; worse when the 95% percentile-bootstrap interval of mean D over 10,000 resamples lies above 0, better when below, a tie otherwise; fewer than 10 pairs are not judged. A worse row counts only when the same cell on 20 fresh seeds is worse too. Floor: the interval of SHD(method) - SHD(empty graph) must lie below 0; it decides a judged row in the lanes at the papers' sizes and in the 100-row cells of m2-bnlearn, where the reference's own interval lies below 0. m2-bnlearn scores every arm on the SHD between equivalence classes. Rows of a mask outside a method's claim (self-masking for EM and MVPC) are reported, not judged. A method passes when no judged row is worse again and no judged row fails the floor.

fresh_seeds.about: no row is worse than its reference, so none ran again on fresh seeds

against_earlier_scheme.about: the alternating scheme against the earlier one, Andrey's EM arm paired on the 20 datasets of a row: D = SHD(alternating) - SHD(one refit per round), judged by the verdict rule; rows where the alternating scheme is worse were not rerun on fresh seeds

last_round_changed.about: fits of Andrey's EM arm whose last round returned another graph than the round before (metadata['em']['graph_changed'][-1]), which log a warning; by_size keys are variables x rows, values [fits whose last round changed the graph, fits]

fit_time_over_earlier_scheme.about: fit time of Andrey's EM arm, alternating over one refit per round, per dataset; the two were fit on different nodes at different times, so single ratios carry the noise of shared nodes; by_size keys are variables x rows

refits.about: two fits of the m2-bnlearn rerun failed on a read of the Python environment's files and were fit again; their records replace the failed ones (a third, which never started, was run when its part resumed)
